data.long_meaning: The name Dhakaa is derived from the Arabic word 'dhakana' which means to strike or to hit. In the Islamic context, it is believed to symbolize the thunderbolt of Allah SWT, representing His immense power and might. It is also associated with the Prophet Moses AS, who was known to perform miracles using the staff of Allah, which would turn into a serpent and strike with a thunderbolt.
data.etymology: Dhakaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunderbolt, Striking.”
